profile: local minimum: A point w⋆ is a local minimum if g(w⋆) ≤ g(w) for all w near w⋆. It is the smallest point with respect to its immediate neighbors. A point is a local or global minimum if ∂2/∂w2 g(v) > 0, since this occurs at convex portions of a function.
